pre_run_business_contract: From accepted C06 both-resource-zero input, keep both P-CREW and P-ALT allocations at zero. Only vary the SubTaskResource.RPROB probability of requiring one resource for the 20-minute INSPECT from one to zero, with a descriptive label change. Mission, deadline, seed, one preparation subtask per aircraft and ARTF two remain unchanged.

expected_native_hypothesis.rprob-0: No resource demand is sampled for either aircraft, INSPECT executes its fixed 20-minute duration without booking, and the mission can launch and succeed.
expected_native_hypothesis.rprob-1: Both aircraft demand a preparation resource, wait without booking, and the mission cancels at the retained finite deadline as in the accepted parent.

limitations: Endpoints alone do not validate intermediate Bernoulli frequency or independent per-aircraft sampling.
Both resource types are zero-capacity; interaction with nonzero capacity is untested.
